podcast.body: A song inspired by the death of Johnny Lydon's mother during the band's active period. "In fact, the band had a song called Death Disco that was inspired by the death of Johnny's mom."

podcast.body: The first single from "Metal Box" was "Death Disco," inspired by the death of Johnny Lydon's mom. It was later retitled "Swan Lake" for the album version, explaining why "Death Disco" might not appear in the liner notes under its original name. "The first single was inspired by the death of Johnny's mom, and it was called Death Disco."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song by Public Image Limited is featured following the account of Johnny Lydon's narrow escape from the Lockerbie bombing in December 1988, highlighting his close brush with death. "Johnny Leiden with public image limited and death disco. He came very, very close to dying in the Lockerbie bombing in December of 1988."
